verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any bulk-operation capability, such as acting on many scenarios, connections, or records in a single call or action. The closest items are webhook queue processing on a schedule and collection-listing API endpoints. These are adjacent features (batched trigger processing and reads), not bulk operations across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
